## About
Protech Auto Body is a family owned and operated independent shop in White Bear Lake. We do body, paint and mechanical work, and our technicians are ASE and ICAR trained and certified in structural analysis, estimating, body, paint and mechanical services.
General Manager Ron Begin graduated from Dunwoody Institute and earned his hands on experience before going on to his ICAR Gold and ASE certifications. We use genuine OE parts and PPG waterborne paint, and every vehicle is quality inspected and detailed before it goes back to you.
Accidents are stressful. We'll take the time to explain the repair, guide you through the process and handle the insurance communications along the way. Make the first phone call to us, and tell your insurer you choose Protech.

## Services
- Structural, frame and unibody repair: Repairing the structure underneath, not just the panels you can see.
- Sheet metal repair and body panel replacement: Fixing or replacing damaged panels after a collision.
- Plastic bumper repairs: Repairing cracked or damaged plastic bumpers.
- Paintless dent repair: For small dents, without repainting.
- Storm and hail damage: Repair for vehicles hit by storms and hail.
- Refinishing and custom painting: Paint work done with PPG waterborne paint.
- Welding and metal fabrication: Metal work for repairs that need it.
- Headlight restoration: Clearing up cloudy, worn headlights.
- Alloy wheel reconditioning: Bringing scuffed or worn alloy wheels back.
- Window tinting
- OEM and aftermarket accessories
- Mobile estimating: We can come to your home or business to write an estimate.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, can email pictures or estimates as needed, and handle insurance communications throughout the repair.

Q: Can I pick my own body shop?
A: Yes. It is always your choice where your car gets repaired. Call us first, then tell your insurer you choose Protech.

Q: Can you write an estimate without me bringing the car in?
A: We offer mobile estimating at your home or business.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
